cases.sentence: Все общество израилетян собралось в ___ и поставило шатер.
cases.translation: All the congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up a tent.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) indicating direction takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: They lived in the territory of Benjamin.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'the territory of Benjamin' uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Граница начиналась от залива в ___ при устье Иордана.
cases.translation: The boundary began from the bay into the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) indicating direction takes the accusative case when expressing motion.

cases.translation: It went up to the city.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Люди прошли по ___ и описали ее.
cases.translation: The people went through the land and described it.
cases.explain: The preposition по (through) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Иисус велел им пройти по ___ и описать ее.
cases.translation: Joshua commanded them to go through the land and survey it.
cases.explain: The transitive verb описать (to describe) takes the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.translation: The inheritance was distributed among the tribe of Benjamin.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: They remained in their inheritance before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Все общество израилетян собралось в Шила и поставило там шатер собрания.
reading.question: Where did the entire congregation of Israel assemble?
options: At Shiloh where they set up the Tent of Meeting
At Mount Sinai in the wilderness
At Jericho by the Jordan River
At Jerusalem in the hill country
reading.correct: At Shiloh where they set up the Tent of Meeting
reading.explain: The text states все общество израилетян собралось в Шила и поставило там шатер собрания (all the congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there).

reading.ru: Страна была покорена ими, но семь израильских родов еще не получили своего удела.
reading.question: How many Israelite tribes had not yet received their inheritance?
reading.explain: The text directly states семь израильских родов еще не получили своего удела (seven Israelite tribes had not yet received their inheritance).

reading.ru: Иисус сказал израилетянам. Сколько вы еще будете ждать, прежде чем пойдете и возьмете в удел землю, которую дал вам Господь, Бог ваших отцов?
reading.question: What did Joshua ask the Israelites about their inheritance?
options: How long would they wait before taking possession of the land?
When would they build the temple?
Which territory should they conquer first?
How many soldiers should they send?
reading.correct: How long would they wait before taking possession of the land?
reading.explain: Joshua asked Сколько вы еще будете ждать, прежде чем пойдете и возьмете в удел землю? (How long will you wait before you go in to possess the land?).

reading.ru: Надел Вениамина. Выпал жребий рода Вениамина по их кланам.
reading.question: What is the main subject being discussed about Benjamin?
options: The inheritance lot for Benjamin's tribe
reading.correct: The inheritance lot for Benjamin's tribe
reading.explain: The heading states Надел Вениамина. Выпал жребий рода Вениамина (Benjamin's inheritance. The lot came out for Benjamin's tribe).

reading.ru: Доставшаяся им земля лежала между наделами родов Иуды и Иосифа.
reading.question: Where was Benjamin's territory located?
options: Between the inheritances of Judah and Joseph
reading.correct: Between the inheritances of Judah and Joseph
reading.explain: The text states доставшаяся им земля лежала между наделами родов Иуды и Иосифа (the land given to them lay between the inheritances of Judah and Joseph).

reading.ru: На севере их граница шла от Иордана по склону к северу от Ерихона и поднималась в Нагорье, доходя до пустыни Бет-Авен.
reading.question: What was the northern boundary of Benjamin's territory?
options: From the Jordan north of Jericho, rising to the hill country and reaching the wilderness of Beth Aven
At Mount Carmel in the north
reading.correct: From the Jordan north of Jericho, rising to the hill country and reaching the wilderness of Beth Aven
reading.explain: The text describes граница шла от Иордана по склону к северу от Ерихона и поднималась в Нагорье, доходя до пустыни Бет-Авен (the boundary went from the Jordan north of Jericho, rising to the hill country, reaching the wilderness of Beth Aven).
